description: Bike Parking Stands DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. This dataset provides annual updates on Bike Parking Stands in Dublin region; encompassing columns such as typestands, Locationstand, Nostands, physicalcondition, oocupancy, expandedcapacity, securitysafetyrating, lighting, protectionweather, largedevelopment, easeaccess, proximitycyclenetwork, commercial, rentail, residential, transportation, education, recreational, entertainment, restaurants, expandedstands, Batch No, X & Y Coordinates. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are ActiveTravel, Bike, Bike Hire, Bike Maintenance Stands, Bike Racks. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
